title: OpferSMP
description: The OpferSMP Resource Pack contains lots of unnecessary and reprehensible content, just the way we like it.
body:
The particularly imaginative OpferSMP resource pack was created to entertain the OpferSMP group of the same name. To make this cultural asset available to others for their enjoyment, this pack is now available here.

Known bugs and issues:

- Cow model broken
- No ideas

Resolved:

- The titles and artists of the modified music discs no longer work since 1.21. (on Minecraft's part)

Special features of this pack:

- Reprehensible and questionable mobs
- Realistic food
- Super cool title screen
- Confuguration using the [Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts) mod.
Have fun with the pack and take it with a grain of salt. Please.
